procedure.method: Fresh independent portfolio review using only the exact pinned inputs. Read the literal packet/case, review rules, rubric, ratio policy, compact addendum/method and adapter; read all five pinned native-evidence manifests without following their embedded producer/source paths. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are empty, so no source image opens or protected-layout reads were applicable. Verified manifest and all fifteen view byte counts/SHA-256 against their pins. Then actually opened and visually inspected all fifteen poster assets using functions.exec -> tools.view_image(detail:'original'), forwarding each returned image_url via image(...,'original'), sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same three-view order. Native dimensions were not assumed to be portrait; packet dimensions are 1672×941 for M1/M2/M3/M5 and 1672×940 for M4, with 720×405 usage and 320×180 thumbnails. No first copy-reading/transcription stage, judgment or score began until after the M5 thumbnail completed the fifteen-view sequence. Retained all ten actual first readings per member in packet order in session memory, with no required-copy fallback. One genuine M1 copy-index-7 glyph uncertainty caused exactly one revisit of that same pinned native asset; its resolved reading and the unchanged first read are both retained. Scores and full-set diversity assess those pixels only. No image generation, editing, peer review access, agent spawning, resume/fork, substitute asset search or claimed runtime session/tool-event identifier.
